result.rationale: The diff's controller `addMembers` action calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"))` without clearing `usernames` (the code even contains `// TODO: should clear the input` acknowledging this), so a second click re-submits the same users. It also discards the returned promise, so a 422 from the new `add_members` endpoint (which the diff's spec shows can occur for automatic groups) yields no user feedback. Both mechanisms are directly visible in the diff and the backend can return 422 per `can_not_modify_automatic`.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `addMembers` action explicitly notes `// TODO: should clear the input` and indeed never clears `this.get("usernames")` after calling `model.addMembers(...)`, so the same usernames can be submitted again (e.g., repeated clicks). Also, it does not `return` or otherwise handle the promise from `this.get("model").addMembers(...)`, so any rejection (e.g. 422 from `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`) is not handled locally in this action. The diff does not show any UI feedback/error handling tied to this action.
